name: Khar'Thyrix
notes: Outer Colonies mobile fortress/refugee ship/black-market hub.
placement_rule: no_fixed_coordinates: mobile asset holds no map placement; position is asserted per-event with a canonical route/drive citation and validated at reconciliation (P2, FABRIC_INVARIANTS v0.1; RULING-FABRIC-SCHEMA 2026-07-21)

derived_capabilities.basis: Extrapolated from the vessel's canonical class (cls_dreadraider, Leviathan-Class Dread-raider) per the reconciliation principle: a vessel inherits its class's established role, features, and complement unless a vessel-specific source overrides.
derived_capabilities.class_role: Mobile fortress, refugee ship, black-market hub, command nexus

identity_key_note: entity_id added 2026-08-09 (canon-identity-key-unification). mobile_asset records historically keyed identity as canonical_id while the other 166 canon records use entity_id, so any tool indexing only entity_id silently skipped every vessel. Both keys hold the same value; canonical_id is retained for back-compat with readers that depend on it (e.g. tools/character_capsule_adapter.py).
